evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Quinton enacts authority-ranking by unilaterally setting a recurring cadence as directive; the maxim-style second clause reinforces command posture.
Framing a list as 'key decisions' enacts authority-ranking — the recorder positions themselves as ratifying which outcomes carry binding weight.
Records the cadence as a settled decision, enacting authority-ranking by treating the directive as established fact rather than proposal.
Assigning a named owner enacts authority-ranking — rank-based allocation of responsibility to a single individual.

mints.name: DirectiveAsMaxim
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a command into an aphoristic principle so the directive reads as self-evident rather than imposed?
